articles.title_en: Song by Russian singer Monetochka cut from Ukrainian version of new ‘Spider-Man’ film
articles.lead_en: The Ukrainian theatrical release of the new Spider-Man film has cut “Monopoliya” (“Monopoly”), a song by Russian singer Monetochka that appears on the film’s soundtrack, according to users on the social network Threads.
